description.p: Euro-Office is a free and open-source office suite comprising editors for text documents, spreadsheets, presentations, PDFs and PDF forms, along with a Diagram Viewer. It lets you create, view and edit office documents stored on your computer without an internet connection, and is fully compatible with Office Open XML formats: .docx, .xlsx, .pptx.

Thanks to the tab-based user interface, you can deal with multiple files within one and the same window. Plugins allow adding extra functionality. Password protection and digital signatures provide a higher level of security while working with files.
Along with offline work, it is possible to connect the application to the cloud for online document collaboration. Available options include Nextcloud, ownCloud, Seafile, Liferay and kDrive.
Euro-Office is a community fork of ONLYOFFICE Desktop Editors, licensed under the GNU AGPL v3.
